data.name: Monster Mash
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Monster Mash, the high-energy, shared-screen party racer where keeping up is the only rule! If you fall off the edge of the screen, you are disqualified for the round. The last monster rolling wins! But getting knocked out is where the real mischief begins...

🎯 Take Revenge from the Sidelines!

Disqualified? No problem! Instantly hop onto the Shooting Range, grab an on-screen target reticle, and take aim at your rivals with rockets, mines and other weaponry. Who says backseat driving can't be fun?

Key Features

  • 8-Player Party Mayhem: Play solo against AI, or team up in local/online Free-for-All and Duo modes (up to 8 players).

  • Wacky Power-Ups: Deflect spectator rockets with flashbangs, or slow down rivals with backhand slaps, oil puddles, and machine guns.

  • 12 Whimsical Tracks: Drift through 12 colorful environments, each packed with unique, interactive obstacles and hazards.

  • Dress Your Monster: Customize your Monster with dozens of silly, unlockable hats and accessories.

  • No Downtime, Just Fun: Rounds transition seamlessly with zero waiting, keeping everyone constantly active and engaged.

  • Custom Tournaments: Easily tweak point systems, round limits, power-up frequencies, and allowed weapons for your perfect Monster Mash tournament.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
